_note: Every entry below was verified before it was suppressed, not bulk-baselined. This plugin is a DEPENDENT of BuddyNext (Requires Plugins: buddynext), so a hook it consumes is usually fired by the parent rather than by itself - which reads to a single-plugin audit as 'never fired'. Re-verify with: contract-audit.php . --pair=../buddynext

suppressions.reason: FALSE POSITIVE. BuddyNext owns and writes this key - AvatarService::COVER_META = 'buddynext_cover_url' (Profile/AvatarService.php:271), written through save_cover_url(). The audit cannot match a literal read here to a constant-named write there. NOTE for whoever touches ImageWriter: we read the literal while BuddyNext writes the constant, so renaming COVER_META would silently stale this guard and the importer would start overwriting covers members already have. Prefer the service getter if that guard is ever reworked.

BY DESIGN. Activator stamps the installed version so a future upgrade routine can compare against it. Nothing reads it yet because there has been no schema migration to trigger one. Writing it from the first release is what makes a later upgrade path possible at all.

REAL, and kept on purpose. Verified: nothing in BuddyNext, BuddyNext Pro or WPMediaVerse applies this filter today, so the callback never runs.
